description:
FILED s1262 (Sonnet agent, 2026-09-07) while writing docs/caching.md (task #1262), from a live probe on main `46ede39d`.

WHAT: `pcl --cache-info`'s `print_kinds` (in the `pcl` script) iterates a hardcoded `qw(modules proto core xs)` when reporting size/count per cache kind. Since task #1200 (s473p, 2026-09-07) there is a FIFTH cache directory, `<PCL_CACHE_DIR>/evals/` (the string-eval disk cache), and it is never listed -- confirmed live: this box's `~/.pcl-cache/evals/` holds 1004 files (502 entries) and `pcl --cache-info` shows only `modules/ proto/ core/ xs/`.

WHY IT MATTERS: `pcl --cache-info` is documented (README, pcl --help, docs/caching.md) as THE one diagnostic for "PCL did not notice my change" and for seeing what a cache holds. A user debugging why an eval-heavy program isn't warming up has no way to see the eval cache's size/count through the one tool built for exactly that question.

FIX SHAPE (not designed in detail): add `evals` to `print_kinds`'s `qw(...)` list in `pcl` (around the `sub print_kinds` / `for my $kind (qw(modules proto core xs))` loop). The `modules`-specific breakdown (transpiles/fasls/manifests/failed counts) does not apply to `evals/` (no fasls there) -- decide whether it gets its own breakdown (`.lisp`/`.deps` counts, matching \%p-eval-cache-read's file pair) or just a size+count line like `proto/`/`core/`/`xs/`. Guard: a `Pl/t` row asserting `evals/` appears in `--cache-info` output after at least one cached eval has run.

BAR: one Opus (or Sonnet) session; no generation bump (perl-side only); gate + a focused Pl/t guard; inverse-verify the guard fails on the parent commit.

=== DONE (s488b) ===

Closed as a by-product of #1841 (the script cache), which had to touch the
same two lists.

`pcl --cache-info`'s `print_kinds` walked `qw(modules proto core xs)`; it now
walks `qw(modules scripts evals proto core xs)`, so `evals/` is counted and
sized beside the others (7,944 files / 1.7 MB on this box) and the new
`scripts/` population is counted separately from `modules/`.

AND THE SAME ABSENCE WAS IN `--clear-cache`, which this task had not noticed:
its glob was `modules/* *.fasl *.lisp`, so it left every eval entry standing
while the help text claimed it removed "everything PCL made".  Both
directories are now named.

Guard: `Pl/t/cache-surface-01.t` (the `--cache-info` surface rows).
subject: DONE s488b: `pcl --cache-info` did not list the evals/ directory (string-eval disk cache, #1200) -- and `--clear-cache`'s glob did not name it either, so it left every eval entry standing while claiming to remove everything PCL made; both fixed with #1841's scripts/ population
